source: tacenta-spec/protocol/message-format.md (Message size: the sender's rule, the receiver's rule (the size rule), Precedence, and the effects of both refusals); tacenta-spec/protocol/error-handling.md (Conditions a caller must act on are named: PlaintextTooLong; A frame the size rule refuses is a decode failure; The order of checks); tacenta-spec/protocol/session-establishment.md (Sending the initial message; Receiving the initial message); tacenta-spec/protocol/mlkem-braid.md (Failure: 'it refuses encrypt and decrypt with AgreementFailed', and a plaintext or frame too long is refused as too long first)
provenance: Supplement version 2 to session-operation-trace.json, added by the maintainer account with tool assistance, with tacenta-core, the model and the Rust runner in view. Not independently authored, and not read by the independent operation reader (session-operation-trace-supplement.md, Provenance).

traces.comment: Supplement trace 1: the sender's rule on a pending initiator's first initial message and on an established session; the refusal changes nothing and draws nothing, and a send of exactly MAX_PLAINTEXT_LEN bytes on the established session is accepted (message-format.md, Message size, the sender's rule; session-establishment.md, Sending the initial message).

fixtures.alice-pending: Alice's session, pending, just returned by establish-initiator against Bob's published bundle, before any send
fixtures.alice-established: Alice's session after Bob's reply to her first initial message has decrypted, so established

traces.comment: Supplement trace 2: on a session whose agreement has failed, a plaintext over MAX_PLAINTEXT_LEN is refused as PlaintextTooLong, the sender's rule being the send's first check, and a short one is then refused as AgreementFailed; neither changes the session (message-format.md, Message size, the sender's rule; mlkem-braid.md, Failure).

fixtures.bob-failed: Bob's responder session after an authenticated receive moved its Braid to Failed (as in version 1's braid-terminal-failure-persists-and-refuses)

traces.comment: Supplement trace 3: responder establishment refuses an initial message one byte over MAX_INITIAL_FRAME_LEN as too long, a decode failure, before any lookup; the store, its one-time prekeys and its replay record are unchanged and nothing is drawn, so the genuine message then establishes and consumes the one-time prekeys it names (message-format.md, Message size; session-establishment.md, Receiving the initial message).

fixtures.bob-store: Bob's prekey store, holding the one-time curve and KEM prekeys Alice's initial message names
fixtures.alice-initial: Alice's first initial message, whose ciphertext authenticates
fixtures.alice-initial-oversized: alice-initial followed by zero bytes up to MAX_INITIAL_FRAME_LEN + 1 = 1050363 bytes

traces.comment: Supplement trace 4: an established session refuses a ratchet frame one byte over MAX_RATCHET_FRAME_LEN as too long, with no change and no draw, and then accepts the genuine message (message-format.md, Message size).

fixtures.bob-established: Bob's responder session, established from Alice's first initial message
fixtures.alice-next: Alice's next message to Bob, sent after his reply, whose ciphertext authenticates
fixtures.alice-next-oversized: alice-next followed by zero bytes up to MAX_RATCHET_FRAME_LEN + 1 = 1048711 bytes

traces.comment: Supplement trace 5: a repeated initial message re-wrapped with an empty kem_ciphertext around a ratchet message one byte over MAX_RATCHET_FRAME_LEN is refused as too long by rule 2, although the whole frame is within MAX_INITIAL_FRAME_LEN and the session never reads kem_ciphertext; then the genuine repeat is accepted (message-format.md, Message size; session-establishment.md, Receiving the initial message).

fixtures.bob-established: Bob's responder session, established from Alice's first initial message
fixtures.alice-repeat: Alice's second initial message, a repeat of the first, sent while her session is still pending
fixtures.alice-repeat-nested-oversized: alice-repeat with its kem_ciphertext emptied (kem_ciphertext_len 0) and its ratchet message followed by zero bytes up to MAX_RATCHET_FRAME_LEN + 1 = 1048711 bytes, so a frame of 1048795 bytes

traces.comment: Supplement trace 6: a session whose agreement has failed refuses an oversized frame as too long, a decode failure, not as AgreementFailed, and draws nothing; a frame within the bounds is then refused as AgreementFailed (message-format.md, Message size; mlkem-braid.md, Failure).

fixtures.bob-failed: Bob's responder session after an authenticated receive moved its Braid to Failed
fixtures.alice-repeat: Alice's initial message for that session, a repeat of the one that established it, sent while her session is still pending
fixtures.alice-repeat-oversized: alice-repeat followed by zero bytes up to MAX_INITIAL_FRAME_LEN + 1 = 1050363 bytes

traces.comment: Control: declares that a send of MAX_PLAINTEXT_LEN + 1 bytes on an established session is accepted. Every consumer must report this trace as failing.

fixtures.alice-established: Alice's session after Bob's reply to her first initial message has decrypted, so established
